derivation:
by
  change ‖x‖ ≤ 1 ↔ Valued.v x ≤ 1
  exact Valued.toNormedField.norm_le_one_iff (Γ₀ := ℤᵐ⁰) (x := x)
explanation: Specialize the rank-one valued-field lemma to p.adicCompletion ℚ. Its norm is definitionally the induced norm, and membership in adicCompletionIntegers is definitionally Valued.v x ≤ 1.
